rust_summary: `native_set_block_tag(dimension, pos, tag)`: a block entity's data set from a compound, in any loaded level.
doc_summary: `native_set_block_tag(dimension, pos, tag)` gives the block entity at `pos` in the loaded level `dimension` the data `tag` (a compound, as `save` writes a block entity: no id or position, which stay), as a paste or a schematic restores a chest's items or a sign's text once the block is placed. True when its data changed; false also when it already holds `tag`, when there is no block entity at `pos`, and on a client. Bundles need "hooks": @API:set_block_tag@.
